# Fake-server wrapper relocation updates both packaging namespace and every changed importer

The four wrappers move from mail/base/test to mailnews/test/fakeserver with identical old/new Git blobs. Registration moves from unqualified TESTING_JS_MODULES to its mailnews namespace; the changed direct importers and ServerTestUtils constructor map use matching resource URLs. Preserve uppercase protocol wrapper filenames versus lower-level Imapd/Pop3d-style daemon modules. This is a test-resource packaging move, not a protocol implementation change or proof all tests passed.

Scope: mailnews-fakeserver-test-packaging.
